factor_policy: Each series needs a frozen code, source, CNY basis, total-return definition and complete range. Missing series block real estimation and are never proxied by a price index or yield change.

allowed_evidence: DR007 historical vendor workbook cache with locked SHA256
current fund tracking-index metadata cross-checked to objective and benchmark text
next-calendar-day NAV scenario only where vendor ann_date is a delayed periodic-report date

universe_rules.contract_pool: verified fixed-income-primary contract; NAV-denominated stock upper <= 0.40; equity or convertible enhancement allowed
universe_rules.style_pool: latest four and at least two public reports; every stock <= 0.40; median stock <= 0.30; median bond including convertibles >= 0.50; latest report age <= 200 days
universe_rules.membership_effective: only after source information is public

final_holdout_policy: Open once only after model family, universe, factors, metrics and selection are frozen. No v3 implementation step opens it.
